timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hey folks, my name is Frank Proctor. My brand of shooting is fast, accurate and easy.
I've been shooting professionally since 2004 as a Green Beret for 15 years and a USPSA Grandmaster for 9 years.
In my courses, I bring those experiences and abilities along with a very open and explorative mind towards shooting.
I don't know everything that there is and know about shooting. I continue to learn something new every day and I love that.
My shooting process requires the mastery of only five components. Processing, control, mechanics, movement, and the middle game.
My brand of shooting is fast, accurate and easy. The information I offer in my training will help you succeed in combat or competition.
Whether you're watching these videos or you come out and train with me, where are you going to get? I'll show you how to set something up. I'll run it for you.
I'll show you how to run it. I'll show you all the little things you can get out of it so that you can better invest your training time to condition yourself to be successful as a shooter.
You'll check out FPTV. There are detailed videos on there with information on training and gear to help you shoot fast, accurate, easy, and new videos added every week.
